label: input p as first token (weakly: p second after w/z/b/s)
explanation: Fires only in the original phase when the input token is p at the first or second position. At t=0 with input p it fires on every such sequence at near-constant max magnitude (~1.27; 98% of activation mass). It also fires weakly (~0.1-0.25, about 0.1-0.2 of max) when p is input at t=1 directly after w, z, b or s. It never fires on p at later positions, on p after other first tokens, on any other input token, or in the delimiter or copy phases. The simpler predicate t==0 & in_tok==p already gets F1 0.94 and mass recall 0.98 on dev.

issues: None material. On the test split the predicate scores precision 1.0, recall 1.0, F1 1.0 and mass recall 1.0, with 0 missed activations and 0 false positives in misses --split test.

The dev profile confirms the factual claims. All activation mass is in the original phase, with 0 activations in the delimiter or copy phases. 98.0% of the mass is at t=0 and 2.0% at t=1, and nothing fires at t>=2. The only input token that fires is p. Median magnitude equals the max (1.268), which matches 'almost exactly the maximum' for t=0. The low mean (1.141) is consistent with a weak t=1 tail.
Not independently checked: the exact weak magnitude range of 0.1-0.25 at t=1. It only affects how the 2% mass tail is described.
